**Region Midtjylland** (often referred to simply as **Midtjylland** in statistical tables) is one of the five administrative regions of [[danmark|Danmark]]. In the context of the national healthcare quality reports for atrial fibrillation ([[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]]), the region is evaluated on its diagnostic, treatment, and follow-up performance. The region consistently ranks among the top-performing areas in the country, frequently meeting or exceeding national standards for patient care, and contributes comprehensive data to the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]].

### Disambiguation and Administrative Structure
While "Region Midtjylland" is the formal administrative and legal entity responsible for healthcare delivery, "Midtjylland" is the geographical shorthand used extensively in the database's regional breakdowns and tables. Both terms refer to the same regional authority and geographic area. The region's healthcare system is organized into several hospital units and health clusters. Major hospitals include [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]], [[hospitalsenhed-midt|Hospitalsenhed Midt]], [[hospitalsenheden-vest|Hospitalsenheden Vest]], [[regionshospitalet-godstrup|regionshospitalet-godstrup]], [[regionshospitalet-horsens|Regionshospitalet Horsens]], and [[regionshospitalet-randers|Regionshospitalet Randers]] [^src19] [^src28]. At a more localized level, care is coordinated through health clusters such as [[sundhedsklynge-midt|Sundhedsklynge Midt]], [[aarhusklyngen|Aarhusklyngen]], [[goedstrupklyngen|Gødstrupklyngen]], [[horsensklyngen|Horsensklyngen]], [[midtklyngen|Midtklyngen]], [[randersklyngen|Randersklyngen]], and [[klynge-midt|Klynge MIDT]] [^src10]. The region's data authority is represented by quality consultant [[julie-andersen|Julie Andersen]] [^src34].

### Clinical Performance and Quality Indicators
Region Midtjylland demonstrates strong clinical performance across multiple quality indicators for atrial fibrillation, often outperforming other regions like [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]].

- **Indicator 1 (Anticoagulation Treatment):** The region achieves high compliance in prescribing [[antikoagulationsbehandling|antikoagulationsbehandling]] to eligible patients. In the 2023 report, the region scored 93.4% (95% CI: 92.3–94.3) [^src14], and in the 2024 report, it achieved 92.9% (95% CI: 91.9–93.8), comfortably meeting the national standard [^src6].
- **Indicator 2 (Echocardiography):** The region ensures that newly diagnosed patients undergo echocardiography. It met the [[standard-80-percent|Standard: ≥80 %]] with a score of 88% in the 2023 report [^src1] and 86.5% (95% CI: 85.5–87.4) in the 2024 report, marking the highest rate among all Danish regions [^src7].
- **Indicator 3 (Rhythm Control):** While no Danish region currently meets the standard for this indicator, Midtjylland consistently records the highest target fulfillment, achieving 81% compared to the 72.5–75.6% range in other regions [^src32]. In the 2023 report, regional rates varied between 71% and 82%, with no region meeting the standard [^src16].
- **Indicator 4 (Follow-up and Treatment Continuation):** The region meets standards for treatment continuation after 1 and 2 years. For example, it fulfilled the standard for [[indikator-4a1|Indikator 4a1]] with 89.2% [^src29] and [[indikator-4a2|Indikator 4a2]] with 90.4% [^src29]. It also met the standard for [[indikator-4a3|Indikator 4a3]] two years post-index date [^src8]. Notably, within the region, only patients residing in [[midtklyngen|Midtklyngen]] met the standard for [[indikator-4b|Indikator 4b]] with a 58% fulfillment rate [^src9].
- **Indicator 5 (Incidence and Diagnosis):** The region maintains a low and stable incidence rate of atrial fibrillation diagnoses in specific contexts (0.7%, 95% CI: 0.6–0.8), meeting the standard [^src2]. Overall, the national incidence was reported at 3.3 per 1,000 inhabitants, with Midtjylland contributing significantly to this dataset [^src3].
- **Indicator 8 (Ablation/Other procedures):** Regional variation was significant (3.6–34%), with Midtjylland contributing to the broader statistical spread [^src9].

### Mortality and Broader Impact
Mortality rates for atrial fibrillation patients in Midtjylland align with national trends, varying regionally between 7.4% and 7.9% across Denmark [^src27]. The region also supports specialized care, hosting two private cardiology practices ([[praktiserende-kardiologer|Praktiserende kardiologer]]) [^src12]. In the 2024 reporting cycle, Region Midtjylland submitted "Ingen kommentarer" (No comments) regarding its qualitative feedback to the [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] registry [^src13].

By systematically transferring lab results to the National Lab Databank and maintaining high clinical standards, Region Midtjylland plays a pivotal role in Denmark's national strategy to manage and treat atrial fibrillation [^src2].
